Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2001
PUNJAB LAND
PRESERVATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Land Preservation Act, 1927
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th November, 2001]
No. Legis. 13-6/2001, dated
26-11-2001. The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Punjab Land Preservation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in sections 2, 7, 7A, 10, 13 to 18 of Ordinance of 1900

ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2001
PUNJAB LAND
PRESERVATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Land Preservation Act, 1927
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th November, 2001]
No. Legis. 13-6/2001, dated
26-11-2001. The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment in sections 2, 7, 7A, 10, 13 to 18 of Ordinance of 1900.--In
the said Ordinance in sections 2, 7, 7A, 10, .13 to 18 the words "Deputy
Commissioner" wherever occurring shall be substituted by the words and
brackets "District Officer (Revenue)".

Amendment in section 7 of Ordinance II of 1900

ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2001
PUNJAB LAND
PRESERVATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Land Preservation Act, 1927
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th November, 2001]
No. Legis. 13-6/2001, dated
26-11-2001. The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information.
3. Amendment in section 7 of Ordinance II of 1900.--In the said
Ordinance, in proviso of subsection (2) of section 7 the word
"Commissioner" shall be substituted by the words and brackets
"Executive District Officer (Revenue)".

Amendment in section 7A of Ordinance II of 1900

ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2001
PUNJAB LAND
PRESERVATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Land Preservation Act, 1927
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th November, 2001]
No. Legis. 13-6/2001, dated
26-11-2001. The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information.
4. Amendment in section 7A of Ordinance II of 1900.--In the said
Ordinance, in subsection (12) of section 7A the figure " 1887" shall
be substituted by the figures, brackets and word "1967 (XVII of
1967)".

Amendment in section 18 of Ordinance II of 1900

ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2001
PUNJAB LAND
PRESERVATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Land Preservation Act, 1927
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th November, 2001]
No. Legis. 13-6/2001, dated
26-11-2001. The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information.
5. Amendment in section 18 of Ordinance II of 1900.--In the said
Ordinance in section 18--
(1) the figures, commas and word
"13, 14, 15 and 16" shall be substituted by the figures, commas and
word "161, 162, 163 and 164" respectively;
(ii) the figure and semi colon
"1887;" shall be substituted by the figures, brackets and word
"1967 (XVII of 1967)"; and
(iii) the words, comma and figure
"or the corresponding provisions of the Sindh Land Revenue Code,
1879" shall be deleted.
